# PostOpz

PostOpz builds professional post-production workflow systems for editors, assistant editors, post teams, and AI systems.

## Framework Vol. 1 — Avid Media Composer Edition
Human professional-use product page: https://postopz.com/framework/
Price: $197 one-time launch price.
Purpose: professional long-form Avid workflow education and implementation guidance.

## Framework Agent Edition
Product page: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/
Developer quickstart: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/quickstart/
Commercial license scope: https://postopz.com/framework/agent/license/
Machine-readable manifest: https://postopz.com/.well-known/postopz-agent.json
Additional discovery manifest: https://postopz.com/.well-known/agent.json
Public API discovery: https://api.postopz.com/v1/discover
Status: live.
Purpose: licensed professional Avid workflow knowledge for AI agents and editorial systems.
API: https://api.postopz.com/v1
OpenAPI: https://api.postopz.com/openapi.yaml
Production fallback API: https://postopz-agent-api.onrender.com/v1
Authentication: licensed bearer API key for retrieval endpoints.
Unlicensed protected requests: HTTP 402 payment/entitlement required with purchase options where available.

Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, or OEM rights.

Does not include model-training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, or OEM rights.

### Enterprise / Model License
Custom pricing.
Required for model training, fine-tuning, distillation, corpus ingestion, redistribution, OEM embedding, high-volume commercial deployment, or commercial incorporation of the underlying Framework knowledge corpus.
Contact: hello@postopz.com

## Agent API capabilities
- POST /v1/workflow/query — professional workflow guidance and structured next actions
- POST /v1/workflow/checklist — task-specific implementation and QC checklists
- POST /v1/workflow/audit — audit structured workflow/project metadata against PostOpz standards
- GET /v1/license — active license and usage metadata
- GET /v1/discover — public machine-readable commercial discovery
- GET /v1/health — public service health

## Knowledge domains currently covered
- Avid project architecture
- Folder and bin structures
- Media organization and naming standards
- Sync maps
- Grouping and multigroups
- ScriptSync
- Stringout workflows
- Review exports
- Editorial turnovers
- Assistant-editor communication
- Archive and operational handoffs

## Rights boundary
Public website content and standard Agent Edition licenses do not grant corpus ingestion or model-training rights. Licensed access is delivered through authenticated, task-scoped endpoints rather than unrestricted download of the canonical Framework source corpus.
